item.title: Understanding React Hooks: A Deep Dive
item.description: Learn how to master React Hooks with practical examples. This comprehensive guide covers useState, useEffect, useContext, and custom hooks with real-world scenarios.
item.content:encoded:
Understanding React Hooks

React Hooks have revolutionized how we write React components. In this comprehensive guide, we'll dive deep into the most important hooks and how to use them effectively.

useState - Managing Local State

The useState hook is the building block for local state management. Here's a practical example:

const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

useEffect - Handling Side Effects

Learn how to manage side effects, from data fetching to subscriptions.

Read the full article for more examples and best practices.

item.title: CSS Grid Layout: Complete Guide with Examples
item.description: Master CSS Grid with practical examples. Learn how to create complex layouts with rows, columns, and advanced grid features like auto-placement and subgrid.
item.content:encoded:
CSS Grid Layout Mastery

CSS Grid is a two-dimensional layout system that revolutionizes web design. This guide covers everything from basics to advanced techniques.

Basic Grid Syntax

.container {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
}

Advanced Patterns

Learn about grid areas, auto-placement, and responsive design with media queries.

item.title: TypeScript Best Practices for 2024
item.description: Level up your TypeScript skills with these best practices. Learn about types, interfaces, generics, and advanced patterns for production applications.
item.content:encoded:
TypeScript Best Practices

TypeScript has become essential for large-scale JavaScript applications. Here are the best practices you should follow in 2024.

Use Strict Mode

Always enable strict mode in your tsconfig.json for maximum type safety.

Prefer Interfaces for Objects

Use interfaces for object shapes and types for unions/intersections.
